projects.title: Our Story, Your Memories
projects.description:
When we were asked to create a TV commercial for Kujtesa's birthday, our main challenge was to encapsulate the variety of its business ventures in the last two decades, prior to becoming a leading internet and cable TV provider.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dlkffISLOFc

We focused on emotional values, rather than technological abilities associated with this brand, linking the company's growth with a timeline of important historical events marking the growth and development of Kosova itself, before and after the war. 

We Have Liftoff

The super hyped product we were asked to advertise was…
